text:
maria: Heads up - rolled a tightening of the VPC egress rules + stricter IAM condition for keystore access to prod yesterday. Saw a small spike in audit log traffic but thought it was fine.
kevin: saw it too. GPU pool onboarding for eu-west-1 started failing ~03:10 UTC with KMS auth errors.
samir: error snippet from node-join logs:
```
2026-03-20T03:12:47Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed status=AccessDenied principal=infra-node-join role=keystore-read
2026-03-20T03:12:47Z WARN onboarding: node-join aborted id=i-0a1b2c3d
```
jess: is that the IAM condition we added (require: requestTag/environment = "prod")? some nodes don't have tags at join time.
anika: yeah the tagging race is real when ASG boots nodes then cloud-init runs. We saw this pattern in staging but masked by permissive fallback.
maria: my bad, I didn't account for the ephemeral join state. Two asks: 1) temporary exception for keystore decrypt for node-join role in eu-west-1 2) audit sampling so logs don't explode while we iterate.
kevin: +1 for temporary exception. We should scope it to the role and region and timebox 2 hours. Also add a canary to verify no extra access surfaces.
samir: suggested policy diff (inline):
```
- Condition: StringEquals: { "aws:RequestTag/environment": "prod" }
+ Condition: ForAllValues:StringEqualsIfExists: { "aws:RequestTag/environment": "prod" }
```
This lets missing tags through but keeps tagged requests strict.
jess: that sounds safer than blanket allow. But ForAllValues:StringEqualsIfExists is weird for older IAM engines... recommend fallback: allow if principal is infra-node-join role and source region eu-west-1.
anika: Also, the keystore proxy emits audit lines per decrypt call. When node-join retries it multiplies logs; we should enable short-circuit on repeated failures for 5m to reduce noise.
deploy-bot: deploy started by maria: infra/keystore/iam/2026-03-20 - plan -> apply (canary eu-west-1) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: I'll hold on the apply until we have the sampling change in place. If logs keep spiking we'll burn storage and alert SRE budgets.
maria: plan:
- apply policy tweak limited to `infra-node-join-prod` role in eu-west-1 (tsv: 6032110000)
- enable audit-sampler in keystore proxy config: sample_window=300s, thresh=10/min
- monitor node-join success rate and audit log ingestion rate for 45m
- rollback automatically after 2h if anomaly
samir: how do we verify we didn't open a path for other clients? I'd like a short test harness that attempts decrypt with missing tag from a non-node principal.
jess: I can run a quick negative test from my laptop creds (will use aws sts assume-role) and we can assert RequesterPrincipal matches.
anika: add a metric: keystore.decrypt.allowed_by_exception (counter) and make a dashboard patch so we can see counts and region breakdown.
maria: will open PR with topic branch `keystore-join-exception` and tag @kevin for review. I'll also add a terraform change note and a revert commit.
kevin: ack. Also reach out to billing to pre-warn about potential audit storage delta. send to #finance-alerts if > 10GB extra within the window.
samir: alternative longer-term fix: have the onboarding flow set the tag via instance metadata on first contact, and allow the join to be validated against a controller-managed ephemeral token instead of request tag. That avoids IAM dancing.
jess: long-term roadmap item noted. For now can we add a pre-warm step in ASG to attach tags via launch template? quick fix but needs template churn.
anika: I'll draft a follow-up doc for runbook changes: what to do if region onboarding stalls due to keystore conditions + how to flip sampling.
maria: OK rolling the canary now, will post results. Please stand by and only escalate to incidents if node-join rate < 70% for 30m.
(15 minutes later)
maria: canary applied, node-join success jumped from 45% -> 93% in eu-west-1. audit ingress spiked x3 but sampler suppressed most duplicates. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/ops/d/keystore-join
kevin: nice. Please proceed with global rollforward for other regions except ap-south where we schedule a manual cutover.
samir: created test harness and ran negative test. Confirmed non-node principal still denied. Posting logs in case thread needs them.
jess: billing FYI sent to #finance-alerts: predicted +2GB/day during sampling window. :money_with_wings:
anika: creating runbook PR now.
maria: TL;DR: tightened policy caused transient failures at node-join due to tagging race. Mitigation: scoped exception + audit sampling. Follow-ups: launch-template tag fix and ephemeral-token onboarding path. Closing thread after retest tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
